titulo: Fostering Mental Health with Scientific Rigor and Empathy
parrafo_1: América Psychology Clinic was founded to provide a safe, confidential, and welcoming space for individuals, couples, and families.
parrafo_2: Led by Lic. Sofía Reynaga (C.Ps.P. 34892), we combine modern evidence-based therapeutic models (CBT, Contextual, Systemic) with deep human commitment throughout every step of your life.
